deck_title: Lorentz-Larmor r_L = m*v_perp/(|q|*B) magnetic helix gyroradius contraction vs naive fixed-radius helix rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Hendrik Lorentz (1895), Joseph Larmor (1897), and Ernest Lawrence (1930) magnetic cyclotron gyroradius law (balancing Lorentz magnetic force |q|*v_perp*B against centripetal force m*v_perp^2 / r_L so r_L(B) = m*v_perp / (|q|*B) = r_L0 / (1 + u), locking r_active / r_Lorentz = 1.0000x across all 17 magnetic-field stations u = B/B_0 - 1 in [0.000, 1.000] with 0/17 violated) versus naive fixed-radius helix shader (keeping r = r_L0 regardless of B(u) = B_0*(1 + u), which overshoots the Larmor gyroradius by B/B_0 = 1 + u to 1.2500x at S4, 1.5000x at S8, and 2.0000x at S16 across 16/17 stations) and 64-sector cyclotron phase v x B orbit quadrature.
